posts.title: Experiment Map Change
posts.edited: Last Edit: September 02, 2009, 04:02:16 PM by KiZai
posts.html:
Hey all

So, now is your chance to have a say in the location of our survival roleplay gamemode. We will either stay on the current map, city 18, or move to the brighter city 45. The choice is entirely yours.

The poll will close in 3 days, so get your vote in fast!

Feel free to post any opinions/alternatives in this thread, turn it into a discussion.

-KiZai

posts.author: Fallen
posts.title: Re: Experiment Map Change
posts.edited: Last Edit: September 02, 2009, 08:37:16 PM by Fallen
posts.html:
City 18 -
Pros:

Atmospheric.
Kinda 'Spooky street corners and stuff.
Epic Nexus setup.

Cons:
The map is kinda small, Conflict groups are common and gunfights often break out in the square.
Can sometimes be too damn dark.


City 45-

Pro's

Nice size - the separation between the slums/Ghetto/square/industry is very noticeable.
Bright map , daytime - Much easier to see where you are going.
Has those epic secret walls, and trap door basements ect.

Con's
Perhaps too large to be fun.
Not very atmospheric, It is a good map but The Experiment'e Tension is not as good on C45.
Nexus Shield.
